limitations: Isolated authored two-retailer fixture; not live checkout integration.
Fictional postcode areas and street addresses; no real geocoding.
Illustrative local-currency prices, not exchange-rate conversions.
Standard delivery only; no coupons, memberships or freight quantity scaling.
Shipping quotes expose schedules, not a simulated appointment reservation.
Instruction text is retained for manual review; no semantic instruction grader.

carrier_standard_transit.basis: Existing offline freight distance/crossing transit rule, using one-day same-city transit for all origins; source dispatch remains separate.
carrier_standard_transit.sampling_unit: Once per world carrier; shared across retailers. Clamp final standard transit to at least one day.

shipping_policy.fee_sampling_unit: Once per retailer-carrier contract, not per SKU or quote. Transit is carrier-wide; retail customer charges may differ.
shipping_policy.home_delivery_offset_status: Accepted weights. Sample once per retailer-carrier contract and retain across quotes; nonnegative final fees.
shipping_policy.readiness: Supplier lead time when applicable, then origin dispatch, then carrier/service transit. Collection access hours remain distinct from parcel readiness.

free_shipping_threshold.threshold_policy: Accepted round-threshold policy and equal-weight pool. Eligibility is subtotal >= threshold, preserving possible one-SEK shortfalls such as 499 versus 500 without forcing them.
free_shipping_threshold.basis: Eligible item subtotal after item coupons at this retailer; shipping and membership fees do not count.
free_shipping_threshold.scope: Domestic standard home or collection delivery; waives standard shipping charge including domestic distance supplement. Express keeps its extra 40 SEK charge. No automatic cross-border or bulky-charge waiver; explicitly declare covered shipping classes.

delivery_membership.eligible_scale: major_retailer only, including major online retailers when scale and format are separated
delivery_membership.benefit: Same domestic standard shipping waiver, without a basket threshold; express surcharge remains. Explicit shipping-class coverage is required before waiving bulky charges. Membership does not modify dispatch or transit initially.
delivery_membership.state: Explicit membership state separate from ordinary account existence and signed-in state; no membership inference from login alone.
delivery_membership.comparison: Already-active benefits can apply. Newly joining is a separately labelled conditional scenario; include full signup fee for a new single-order comparison unless task defines another accounting scope. No implicit account creation, signup or paid activation.
delivery_membership.outcomes: Do not force membership to be cheapest: threshold promotions may already waive delivery, paid fees may outweigh savings, or another retailer may still win.

product_shipping_class.eligibility: Bulky carrier shipping is home-only; no carrier-counter or locker collection. Retailer branch collection is a separate fulfilment service. Match other carrier-service capabilities explicitly.
product_shipping_class.charges_and_time: Bulky handling can have class-specific fees and transit rules, separate from ordinary parcel tariffs. Numeric rates and capability probabilities remain to be specified.
product_shipping_class.promotions: Declare which classes and fee components a threshold or membership covers; generic free shipping must not silently erase bulky surcharges.

bulky_delivery.carrier_destination: User home only; carrier counters and lockers unavailable. Retailer branch collection is separate.
bulky_delivery.surcharge_sampling_unit: Once per retailer-carrier contract, stable across quotes. Added to ordinary home-delivery charge; geographic/service supplements still apply.
bulky_delivery.transit_sampling_unit: Once per carrier, shared across retailers for bulky shipments; added to service transit, not source dispatch.
bulky_delivery.promotion_sampling_unit: Once per retailer; applies to threshold and delivery-membership benefits initially, independent of basket qualification.

promotion_meanings.waive_all: A qualifying standard-shipping promotion waives ordinary home delivery and bulky surcharge; express surcharge remains if that service exists.
promotion_meanings.waive_base_only: A qualifying promotion waives ordinary home delivery but retains bulky and express surcharges.
promotion_meanings.exclude_bulky: Bulky product tariffs receive no shipping waiver despite subtotal or membership qualification. Regular product tariffs can still qualify. Bulky tariff retains ordinary shipping plus bulky and service supplements; aggregate complete product tariffs by maximum.

bulky_delivery.cart_scope: Accepted default: one consolidated shipment per retailer checkout. Cart shipping is max(complete applicable shipping tariff per product), not summed line fees or base plus an already complete maximum. Evaluate each common carrier/service/destination option separately for the whole cart; do not combine independently optimal line options. Any bulky item excludes carrier collection for the cart.
bulky_delivery.aggregation_order: Compute checkout item subtotal after coupons, determine threshold/membership qualification, apply explicit class treatment to each complete product shipping tariff, then take maximum for the selected common option. Across separate retailer checkouts, add each checkout's shipping charge.
bulky_delivery.middle_policy: waive_base_only discounts the ordinary component of a bulky tariff, retaining its surcharge; it does not split regular and bulky goods into separate shipments.
bulky_delivery.procurement_and_packages: Supplier orders and stock transfers can delay item readiness without automatically creating multiple customer shipments or charges. Default shipment waits for all its items. Remote/split fulfilment is a possible explicit later exception, not the usual checkout model.
bulky_delivery.quantity_scope: No general per-unit freight scaling in the initial model. Manufactured multipacks use their own SKU shipping class/tariff. Quantity-dependent packaging and multiple-origin fulfilment remain deferred.
bulky_delivery.threshold_basis: All eligible item subtotal after coupons counts, including bulky items. Promotion treatment controls shipping waiver separately.
bulky_delivery.terms: Public shipping conditions must state bulky charges and promotion exclusions. Quote components preserve ordinary shipping, bulky surcharge and applied waiver separately.
bulky_delivery.outcomes: Do not force free delivery, cheapest offer or compatible stocked origin.

home_delivery_terms_backlog.scope: Home-delivery arrangements, including whether appointments or delivery windows can be scheduled. Terms attach to retailer-carrier services and agree with selectable options.
home_delivery_terms_backlog.scheduling_semantics: Selectable dates/windows must be explicit. Scheduled delivery does not by itself promise evening availability. Probabilities and concrete slot generation remain to be authored.

sampling_proposal.scheduling_choice_rationale: User-approved: bulky delivery should more often offer a choice. Day or day-and-window selection totals 90% for bulky versus 60% for regular; explicit window selection is 55% versus 25%.
sampling_proposal.scope: Home-delivery terms only, conditional on the carrier offering the shipping class. Service availability, retailer option counts and review outcome rates are separate decisions.
sampling_order: Carrier service terms by shipping class
Carrier access for the user's building

sampling_units.service_terms: Once per world-local carrier and shipping class, shared across retailer bindings and speed tiers initially. Retailers select existing terms rather than resampling them.
sampling_units.building_access: Once per carrier and specific user building, shared across stores and regular/bulky services. A detached house delivers at its door without this apartment-entry draw.
sampling_units.order_context: Dates, recipient presence and unattended-delivery permission belong to the particular order; permission is never inferred from service eligibility.

calendar_proposal.first_eligible_day: After all cart items are ready plus shared carrier/service transit; later slots never arrive earlier than physical readiness. Same canonical estimates feed public terms and task checks.
calendar_proposal.carrier_assigned: Assign the first eligible date; no clock-time window is promised in this initial mode.
calendar_proposal.choose_day: Offer the first eligible date and the next two calendar dates, without a promised clock-time window.
calendar_proposal.choose_day_and_window: Offer the same three dates with explicit four-hour windows in the destination timezone.
calendar_proposal.window_set_sampling_unit: Once per carrier shipping-class service; actual dates instantiated per order. A 16:00-20:00 window is not wholly after 18:00.
calendar_proposal.simplifications: Calendar days including weekends, no cutoffs or capacity depletion, and no extra scheduling fee or independent arrival-time redraw initially.

sampling_proposal.entry_resolution: recipient_opens requires someone present; provided_code_or_intercom requires a working supplied code or someone to answer. authorised_access means confirmed permission/access for this building. Resolved entry always means apartment-door delivery; failure to resolve entry invokes failed-delivery handling rather than a lobby-policy draw.
sampling_proposal.unattended_conditions: Permission to leave the parcel is an explicit order fact. Unattended apartment-door delivery also needs entry without the absent recipient. Initial attended services require a recipient, without a separate signature-policy draw; ID-sensitive goods can override this in future concept rules.

failed_delivery.trigger: A failed home-delivery attempt, such as absent required recipient or unavailable building access; do not manufacture a lobby handoff as the permitted fallback.
failed_delivery.collection_eligibility: Carrier must have a nearby collection point eligible for the shipping class. Otherwise remove redirect_to_collection and renormalize to reattempt; bulky always uses reattempt.
failed_delivery.sampling_unit: Once per carrier shipping-class service, after carrier collection access is known; stable across retailers.
failed_delivery.reattempt: One additional attempt on the next calendar date. A selected delivery window does not automatically survive reattempt; publish the newly assigned date without a clock-time promise in the initial model.
failed_delivery.redirect_to_collection: Use an existing eligible carrier point, with parcel readiness one calendar day after the failed attempt; collection must respect the point's actual access hours. Public terms disclose this fallback and may conflict with a home-only requirement.
failed_delivery.scope_limits: No extra customer charge initially. Exhausted attempts, storage deadlines and return-to-sender timing are deferred, with no unsupported task claims.

review_applicability.punctuality: Requires a dated promise and an observed arrival; distinguish retailer dispatch from the carrier transport leg.
review_applicability.delivery_window_adherence: Requires an explicit promised window for the actual attempt; date-only delivery has no clock-time-window adherence claim.
review_applicability.apartment_door_handoff: Requires an apartment, confirmed entry and door-delivery promise; lobby handoff can then be a complaint about service failure.
review_applicability.failed_delivery_handling: Requires an actual failed attempt and the offered fallback; do not describe collection redirection for a service whose policy is reattempt.
review_applicability.package_handling: Requires an observed parcel condition; attributing damage to the carrier also requires evidence in the underlying history.
review_applicability.communication: Tracking/notification claims require a defined communication feature and history. Those capabilities and outcome rates remain to be authored.
review_applicability.selection: Build the set of supported observations for each historical shipment before selecting statements. Inapplicable topics are excluded; applicable ones need not be mentioned, and several observations may share one comment. Policies constrain facts, while sampled performance can violate a promise.

sampling_proposal.deferred: Numeric historical reliability/failure rates, communication capabilities, review prose and renderer/task integration. Service sampling weights are accepted design settings, not implemented runtime defaults.

building_access_proposal.scope: Carrier-service capability plus actual access conditions at this user's building; no universal carrier key/access assertion.
building_access_proposal.authorised_access: Abstract confirmed entry arrangement for the specific building; no simulated physical keys or credentials are required.
building_access_proposal.delivery_place: Accepted simplification: confirmed building entry means apartment-door delivery. Without entry, handover is at the building entrance and requires the recipient to come downstairs. Do not independently sample a lobby-delivery policy when entry is supported. Room carrying is outside this apartment-access distinction.
building_access_proposal.recipient_presence: Separate handover/presence condition; building access alone does not imply permission to leave goods unattended or skip a required signature.
building_access_proposal.coherence: Bind to available home/building facts, published service terms and confirmed access. Unknown access remains unknown; neither a carrier name nor favourable reviews establishes compatibility.
task_memory_examples: I cannot come downstairs to receive deliveries.
Leave it at my apartment door while I am out.
building_access_proposal.review_experiences: Record promised apartment-door delivery separately from actual historical handoff. A reviewer may report that the driver left the parcel in the lobby despite confirmed entry and door delivery; this is a service failure, not a separately sampled shipping policy. Reports with unknown access or permission must not invent a breach.

home_delivery_terms_backlog.deferred: Implementation of home/building facts and dated slots, communication capabilities, historical outcome sampling and runtime binding.
